title.zh: 一个 token 在 Transformer 内部经历了什么？
title.en: What Happens to a Token Inside a Transformer?

text: 一个 token 在 transformer 内部经历了什么？ what happens to a token inside a transformer? llm 内核 llm internals llm transformer self-attention residual stream agent context 今日命题 today's proposition 昨天我们把模型看成一个函数：给定上下文，输出下一 token 的 logits。今天打开这个函数。对主流 decoder-only llm，更准确的心智模型不是“每个 token 各自被理解”，而是： 所有已有位置都携带一条向量状态；每一层让位置之间受控地通信，再对每个位置独立计算，最后只读取最末位置的状态来预测下一个 token。 一个 token id 本身只是词表中的整数。embedding 把它变成向量；position 让相同 token 在不同位置表现不同；causal self-attention 让当前位置从过去位置读取信息；mlp 在每个位置上变换特征；residual stream 则像一条贯穿网络的共享总线，让各层不断写入修正。经过许多层后，最后位置的向量被投影回词表空间，得到昨天看到的 logits。 这套机制有两个容易混淆的边界。第一，attention 不是数据库查询：它根据当前激活动态混合上下文中已有位置的 value，不能直接访问训练语料或外部世界。第二，attention weight 不是完整解释：它只描述一次读取中的混合系数，后续 value、output projection、mlp 与 residual addition 都会改变结果。把一张 attention 热图当成模型因果解释，往往比它能支持的结论更强。 今天要建立的边界： transformer 把上下文压缩成每个位置的连续向量状态，并通过多层受限通信逐步加工；它没有显式、持久、可寻址的“事实表”，也没有越过 runtime 权限边界。 yesterday we treated the model as a function that maps context to next-token logits. today we open that function. for a modern decoder-only llm, the useful mental model is not that each token is understood in isolation. instead, every existing position carries a vector state; each layer lets positions communicate under constraints and then computes locally at every position; finally, the state at the last position is read to predict the next token. a token id is merely an integer in a vocabulary. an embedding turns it into a vector; positional information makes the same token behave differently at different locations; causal self-attention lets the current position read from earlier positions; an mlp transforms features independently at each position; and the residual stream acts like a shared bus through the network, with every layer writing an update. after many layers, the vector at the final position is projected back into vocabulary space to produce the logits from yesterday. two boundaries are easy to blur. first, attention is not a database query. it dynamically mixes values already represented at context positions; it cannot directly consult the training corpus or the external world. second, attention weights are not a complete explanation. they describe mixture coefficients for one read operation, while value vectors, output projections, mlps, and later residual additions all alter the result. treating an attention heat map as a causal account generally claims more than the mechanism supports. the boundary to establish today: a transformer compresses context into continuous vector states and refines them through many layers of constrained communication. it contains no explicit, persistent, addressable fact table, and it never crosses the runtime's permission boundary. 连接你熟悉的 agent context connect it to the agent context you know 在 agent runtime 中，你会构造一串消息：system instruction、用户目标、工具 schema、历史 tool call、tool result，再交给模型。api 层看起来像带角色的对象数组；进入模型前，它们会被模板化并 tokenization，最终成为一个线性 token 序列。角色、消息边界和工具调用标记通常也是 token 或 token pattern，而不是 transformer 内部独立的安全通道。 因此，模型所谓“看到 context”，实际是每个位置都接收一个初始向量，然后在 causal mask 约束下从左侧位置聚合信息。较晚的用户请求可以读取较早的 system instruction；较晚的 tool result 也可能读取网页里注入的恶意文本。反方向则不成立：早先位置在同一次 forward pass 中不能读取未来位置。这种方向性是 next-token generation 成立的基础，却不会自动编码“system 比 tool result 更可信”。authority hierarchy 主要由训练模式和 runtime 拼接约定影响，真正权限仍必须在模型外执行。 还要区分 context 与 memory。context token 会影响本次 forward pass 的激活；会话结束后，这些激活不会自动写回模型参数。把历史再次放进 prompt、从外部 memory store 检索、或做 fine-tuning，才是跨调用保留信息的不同机制。长 context 给的是临时可访问材料，不等于模型拥有稳定、精确、永久的记忆。 in an agent runtime, you assemble system instructions, a user goal, tool schemas, prior tool calls, and tool results, then send that message sequence to the model. the api exposes role-tagged objects, but before inference they are formatted and tokenized into one linear token sequence. roles, message boundaries, and tool-call markers are generally tokens or token patterns, not physically separate security channels inside the transformer. when we say the model sees context, every position actually starts with a vector and then aggregates information from positions to its left under a causal mask. a later user request can read an earlier system instruction; a later tool result can also read malicious language embedded in a web page. the reverse direction is blocked: an earlier position cannot read future positions in the same forward pass. this directionality enables next-token generation, but it does not inherently encode that system text is more trustworthy than tool output. training patterns and runtime formatting influence authority behavior; actual permissions must still be enforced outside the model. context must also be separated from memory. context tokens affect activations during this inference call; when the call ends, those activations are not automatically written into model parameters. re-inserting history into a prompt, retrieving from an external memory store, and fine-tuning are different persistence mechanisms. a long context provides temporarily accessible material, not stable, exact, permanent memory. 逐层追踪最后一个位置 trace the final position layer by layer 以下追踪一次 decoder-only transformer 的 forward pass。为简化说明，忽略不同模型在 rmsnorm/layernorm、bias、并行 residual、grouped-query attention 等实现差异；这些差异影响速度和训练稳定性，但不改变主数据流。 1. token id 变成 residual stream 的初始状态 tokenizer 产生长度为 n 的 id 序列。embedding matrix e 为每个 id 查出维度为 d 的向量，组成矩阵 x⁰ ∈ rⁿˣᵈ 。这不是词典释义，而是一组训练学到的坐标。一个 token 的语法、语义和格式特征没有固定分区；特征可能分布在许多维度和位置组合中。 模型还必须知道顺序。原始 transformer 把 sinusoidal positional encoding 加到 embedding。许多现代模型使用 rope：它不直接给 residual stream 加一个位置向量，而是按位置旋转 query 和 key 的二维分量，使注意力点积携带相对位置信息。无论具体方案如何，位置不是装饰性 metadata；没有它，self-attention 对 token 排列近似 permutation-invariant，“狗咬人”与“人咬狗”就缺少结构差异。 2. attention sublayer：当前位置决定读谁、读什么 每层先规范化 residual state，再用三个线性投影生成 query、key、value。对某个 head，位置 i 的 query 与所有允许位置 j ≤ i 的 key 做点积；softmax 把分数变成总和为 1 的权重；这些权重再混合 value。直觉上，query 表示当前位置正在寻找的模式，key 表示某位置愿意以什么模式被匹配，value 表示匹配后真正搬运的内容。query-key 决定 routing，value 决定 payload。 多头 attention 同时运行多个较小的读取通道。一个 head 可能在某些输入上表现出复制分隔符、跟随句法依赖或追踪前文实体的模式，但不能假设每个 head 都有一个稳定的人类标签。各 head 输出拼接后经过 output projection，形成对 residual stream 的一次更新，而不是替换原状态。 decoder-only transformer 中最后位置的数据流 token embedding 和位置信息进入 residual stream；每层先通过 causal self-attention 从过去位置读取，再通过 mlp 计算，两次结果都加回 residual stream；最终规范化和 unembedding 产生下一 token logits。 token embedding + 位置信息 重复 n 层 causal self-attention 从 j ≤ i 的位置读取 + 加回 residual stream mlp / ffn 每个位置独立变换特征 + 加回 residual stream final norm 读取最后位置 unembedding d → vocabulary next-token logits softmax / decoding residual stream 跨层保留并累积更新 原创示意：attention 负责跨位置通信，mlp 负责位置内计算；二者都只向 residual stream 写入增量，最终最后位置被读成词表 logits。 3. mlp sublayer：在每个位置上计算 attention 让信息跨位置移动，mlp/ffn 则对每个位置应用相同参数的非线性变换，通常先扩展维度、经过激活或 gated activation，再投影回模型维度。它可以检测输入特征组合并写入新特征。把 attention 简称为“通信”、mlp 简称为“计算”并不完美，却是有用的工程近似：没有 attention，位置之间难以动态交换信息；没有 mlp，多层线性混合的表达能力会受限。 4. residual stream：各层共享的工作区 在 pre-norm 架构中，一层可粗略写成： x = x + attention(norm(x)); x = x + mlp(norm(x)) 。加号非常重要。每个 sublayer 贡献一个增量，已有表示仍沿 residual path 前进。这改善深层网络的梯度传播，也允许不同层在同一向量空间中累积、覆盖或组合特征。所谓 residual stream 不是模型源码里必然存在的数据库对象，而是理解这些跨层向量状态的分析框架。 5. 最后位置变成 logits 完成所有层后，对最后位置状态做 final norm，再乘 unembedding matrix，得到词表中每个候选 token 的 logit。很多模型将 input embedding 与 output unembedding 权重绑定，但这不是概念上的必要条件。softmax 和 decoding 选择一个 token；该 token 追加到序列后，模型再次运行。昨天的 autoregressive loop，就建立在今天这条单次 forward path 上。 the following traces one forward pass through a decoder-only transformer. to keep the mechanism visible, we set aside implementation differences such as rmsnorm versus layernorm, bias terms, parallel residual branches, and grouped-query attention. those choices affect efficiency and training stability, but the main dataflow remains recognizable. 1. token ids initialize the residual stream the tokenizer produces a sequence of n integer ids. an embedding matrix e looks up a vector of width d for every id, producing x⁰ ∈ rⁿˣᵈ . an embedding is not a dictionary definition. it is a learned coordinate vector. syntax, meaning, and formatting are not stored in fixed compartments; features may be distributed across many dimensions and combinations of positions. the model must also represent order. the original transformer added sinusoidal positional encodings to token embeddings. many modern models use rotary position embeddings, or rope. rather than simply adding a position vector to the residual stream, rope rotates pairs of query and key coordinates according to position, so their dot product carries relative-position structure. whatever the specific scheme, position is not decorative metadata. without it, self-attention is approximately permutation-equivariant and has little basis for distinguishing “dog bites human” from “human bites dog.” 2. the attention sublayer: each position decides where and what to read at each layer, the residual state is normalized and passed through three learned linear projections that produce queries, keys, and values. for one attention head, the query at position i is dotted with keys at every allowed position j ≤ i . a softmax converts those scores into weights that sum to one, and the weights mix the value vectors. a useful intuition is that a query describes the pattern the current position is looking for, a key describes how a position can be matched, and a value contains what is actually transported after a match. query-key similarity controls routing; values carry the payload. multi-head attention runs several smaller read channels in parallel. on particular input distributions, a head may exhibit behavior such as copying a delimiter, following a syntactic dependency, or tracking an earlier entity. it is unsafe, however, to assume that every head has one stable human-readable job. the head outputs are concatenated and passed through an output projection. the result becomes an update to the residual stream rather than replacing the prior state. dataflow for the final position in a decoder-only transformer token embeddings and position information enter the residual stream. every layer reads prior positions through causal self-attention, computes through an mlp, and adds both updates to the stream. final normalization and unembedding produce next-token logits. token embedding + position repeat n layers causal self-attention read positions j ≤ i + add to residual stream mlp / ffn transform each position + add to residual stream final norm read last position unembedding d → vocabulary next-token logits softmax / decoding residual stream preserve + accumulate original explanatory diagram: attention communicates across positions, while the mlp computes within each position. both write increments into the residual stream; the final position is eventually read into vocabulary logits. 3. the mlp sublayer: compute independently at each position attention moves information between positions. the mlp, or feed-forward network, applies the same nonlinear transformation independently to every position. it usually expands the hidden width, passes activations through a nonlinearity or gated activation, and projects back to the model width. it can detect combinations of incoming features and write new features. describing attention as communication and the mlp as computation is imperfect but useful: without attention, positions cannot dynamically exchange information; without nonlinear mlps, repeated linear mixtures would have limited expressive power. 4. the residual stream: a shared workspace across layers in a pre-normalization architecture, one layer can be sketched as x = x + attention(norm(x)); x = x + mlp(norm(x)) . the plus signs matter. each sublayer contributes an increment while the prior representation continues down the residual path. this improves gradient flow through deep networks and lets different layers accumulate, overwrite, or combine features in a shared vector space. the residual stream is not necessarily a database object named that way in model source code; it is an analytical frame for the vector state carried across layers. 5. the final position becomes logits after all layers, the final position is normalized and multiplied by an unembedding matrix, yielding one logit for every vocabulary candidate. many models tie the input embedding and output unembedding weights, although weight tying is not conceptually required. softmax and the decoding policy select a token. that token is appended to the sequence, and the model runs again. yesterday's autoregressive loop is built from repeated executions of today's single forward path. 必要数学：attention 是加权读取 essential math: attention is a weighted read 设某层规范化后的状态为 x ∈ rⁿˣᵈ 。一个 attention head 使用训练得到的矩阵生成： q = xw q , k = xw k , v = xw v n 是序列长度， d 是模型宽度，head dimension 记为 dₖ 。 wq、wk、wv 不是运行时检索表，而是训练学到的线性投影。对所有位置并行计算时，scaled dot-product attention 为： a = softmax((qkᵀ / √dₖ) + m), o = av qkᵀ 给出每个 query 与每个 key 的相似分数。除以 √dₖ 是为了在维度增大时控制点积尺度，避免 softmax 过早饱和。 m 是 causal mask：当 j i 时加入负无穷，使位置 i 对未来位置的权重变为 0。 a 的每一行是一次概率型 routing； o 则是 value 的加权和。 这个公式揭示 attention 的容量限制：每个 head 在每个位置输出固定宽度的向量，无论它读取 20 个还是 20,000 个 token。它不是把全部上下文无损复制到当前状态，而是在当前 query 驱动下压缩。多个重要事实可能竞争有限的表示带宽；信息虽然位于窗口内，也可能没有被正确路由或在后续层中被稀释。 一层的 residual 更新可抽象成： x′ = x + attn(norm(x)); x″ = x′ + mlp(norm(x′)) 这里的加法使各层可以保留 identity path，同时叠加修正。最终，对最后位置 hₙ ： z = w u norm(hₙ), p(token=j)=softmax(z) j wu 把 d 维状态投影到 vocabulary 大小； z 是 logits。注意，只有最后位置直接产生当前的 next-token distribution，但它通过多层 attention 间接汇集了可访问的前文信息。生成新 token 后，序列长度从 n 变为 n+1 ，再预测下一项。 let the normalized state entering an attention sublayer be x ∈ rⁿˣᵈ . one attention head uses learned matrices to produce: q = xw q , k = xw k , v = xw v here n is sequence length, d is model width, and the head dimension is dₖ . wq, wk, and wv are learned linear projections, not runtime lookup tables. when all positions are computed in parallel, scaled dot-product attention is: a = softmax((qkᵀ / √dₖ) + m), o = av qkᵀ contains the similarity score between every query and key. dividing by √dₖ controls the scale of dot products as dimensionality grows, preventing the softmax from saturating too early. m is the causal mask: it contributes negative infinity when j i , making the weight from position i to a future position zero. each row of a acts like probabilistic routing; o is the corresponding weighted sum of values. the equation exposes a capacity constraint. each head emits a fixed-width vector at each position whether it reads 20 tokens or 20,000. it does not copy the full context losslessly into the current state; it compresses under the current query. several important facts can compete for limited representational bandwidth. information can be physically inside the context window yet fail to be routed correctly or become diluted by later computation. a residual block can be abstracted as: x′ = x + attn(norm(x)); x″ = x′ + mlp(norm(x′)) the additions preserve an identity path while allowing each sublayer to contribute a correction. finally, for the last position hₙ : z = w u norm(hₙ), p(token=j)=softmax(z) j wu projects a width- d state into vocabulary size, and z contains the logits. only the final position directly produces the current next-token distribution, but through repeated attention it can indirectly gather accessible information from the prefix. after one token is emitted, sequence length grows from n to n+1 , and the model predicts again. 对 agent 系统的影响 implications for agent systems 1. prompt ordering 会改变计算图 把同一句 instruction 放在开头或靠近当前生成位置，不只是文案差异。位置编码、causal direction 和多层 routing 都会变化。靠后的 token 可以读取靠前内容，但信息必须经过有限宽度的 attention/representation 通道。重要约束应简洁、稳定，并在长轨迹中由 runtime 必要时重新呈现；不要假设一次写在最开头就会被无损保留。 2. tool result 越长，不代表 observation 越强 大量日志扩大可读取集合，也增加竞争项和计算成本。真正需要的错误码可能被几千行重复输出淹没。先由确定性代码提取结构、保留原始引用和 provenance，再把高信号 observation 送入模型，通常比无差别塞满窗口更可靠。 3. message role 不是硬隔离 system、user、tool 内容最终共同影响 hidden states。特殊 token 和训练可以让模型学会区分角色，却不能像操作系统权限一样阻止低信任文本影响生成。prompt injection 正是利用这种共享计算表面。外部数据应带来源和信任标签，工具执行仍需 policy gate。 4. hidden state 不是 durable workflow state 模型可能在 residual stream 中暂时表示计划、实体或不确定性，但这些状态不可由 runtime 稳定寻址，也会在调用结束后消失。任务阶段、已执行副作用、幂等键、审批与恢复点应保存在显式状态机或数据库里，而不是寄希望于“模型记得”。 5. context window 是上限，不是保证 一个事实位于可接受的 token 范围内，只说明数学上可以被 attention 读取，不说明模型必然选择它、正确组合它或在最终 logits 中保留它。agent eval 应专门改变关键事实的位置、干扰项数量和 observation 长度，而不是只在理想短 prompt 上测试。 1. prompt ordering changes the computation graph putting the same instruction at the beginning or near the current generation point is not merely a copy-editing difference. position encoding, causal direction, and routing across layers all change. later tokens can read earlier material, but that material must travel through fixed-width attention and representation channels. critical constraints should be concise and stable, and the runtime may need to re-present them during long trajectories. do not assume that one statement at the beginning is preserved losslessly forever. 2. a longer tool result is not necessarily a stronger observation large logs expand the readable set, but they also add competing candidates and computation. the decisive error code can be buried under thousands of repetitive lines. deterministic preprocessing that extracts structure, preserves raw references and provenance, and sends a high-signal observation is often more reliable than filling the window indiscriminately. 3. message roles are not hard isolation boundaries system, user, and tool content ultimately influence shared hidden states. special tokens and training can teach the model to treat roles differently, but they do not prevent low-trust text from influencing generation the way an operating-system permission boundary would. prompt injection exploits this shared computational surface. external data needs provenance and trust metadata, while tool execution still requires an out-of-model policy gate. 4. hidden state is not durable workflow state a model may temporarily represent a plan, entity, or uncertainty in its residual stream, but the runtime cannot reliably address those features and they disappear after the call. task phase, completed side effects, idempotency keys, approvals, and recovery checkpoints belong in an explicit state machine or database, not in the hope that the model remembers. 5. context window size is a limit, not a guarantee a fact being inside the accepted token range means attention can mathematically read it. it does not mean the model will select it, combine it correctly, or preserve it into final logits. agent evaluations should vary the position of critical facts, the number of distractors, and observation length rather than testing only ideal short prompts. 取舍与失败模式 trade-offs and failure modes 全局 attention 的表达力与平方成本： 标准 attention 要形成 n×n 的 score 关系，训练或 prefill 的计算/显存随序列长度快速增长。flashattention 等实现减少内存读写并避免显式物化完整矩阵，但没有把语义问题变成免费；稀疏、局部或线性 attention 则以不同方式牺牲任意位置间直接交互。 绝对位置、相对位置与外推： learned absolute embedding 简单，却绑定训练过的位置范围；sinusoidal encoding 有解析结构；rope 让点积自然带相对位置信号，并成为许多 decoder llm 的选择。任何方案在超出训练长度时都可能退化。把模型配置中的 context limit 调大，不等于它学会在新长度上可靠推理。 可见不等于可用： 研究中常见“lost in the middle”现象：模型对长输入中间位置的信息利用弱于开头或结尾。具体程度依模型、任务和训练而异，不能把它当成所有模型固定曲线；工程上应通过目标模型 eval 决定是否重排、摘要或检索，而非凭传说设计。 attention weight 的解释陷阱： 高权重说明某个 head 在该层将更多 value 混入当前位置，不等于该 token 对最终答案具有最大因果影响。value 可能接近零，output projection 可抵消它，后续层也能覆盖它。需要因果干预、activation patching 或端到端行为测试，才可提出更强解释。 压缩与污染是一体两面： attention 能把远处信息路由到当前状态，也能把 prompt injection、错误工具输出和无关模式路由进来。模型内部没有通用的“可信 attention”。agent runtime 需要在进入 context 前做 provenance、隔离、解析和最小化暴露。 最常见的误判： “在窗口里”被当成“模型会记住”；“attention 到它”被当成“它导致了答案”；“角色 token 不同”被当成“权限隔离”。三者都把统计计算表面误当成确定性系统边界。 expressive global attention versus quadratic cost: standard attention relates n queries to n keys, and training or prefill cost grows quickly with sequence length. implementations such as flashattention reduce memory traffic and avoid materializing the full score matrix in slow memory, but they do not make semantic use of context free. sparse, local, and linear attention variants trade away unrestricted direct interaction in different ways. absolute position, relative position, and extrapolation: learned absolute embeddings are simple but tied to positions observed during training. sinusoidal encodings provide analytic structure. rope makes dot products carry relative-position information and is widely used in decoder llms. every scheme can degrade outside its training regime. increasing a configured context limit does not mean the model has learned reliable reasoning at the new length. visible does not mean usable: long-context studies often find a “lost in the middle” pattern, where information in the middle of a long input is used less reliably than material near the beginning or end. the magnitude depends on model, task, and training; it is not a universal fixed curve. engineers should use evaluations on the target model to decide whether to reorder, summarize, or retrieve context rather than designing from folklore. the attention-weight interpretation trap: a high weight means one head at one layer mixed more of a position's value into the current output. it does not prove that token had the greatest causal effect on the final answer. the value may be near zero, the output projection may cancel it, and later layers may overwrite it. stronger explanations require causal intervention, activation patching, or end-to-end behavioral tests. compression and contamination are two sides of routing: attention can route a distant constraint into the current state, and it can route prompt injection, erroneous tool output, or irrelevant patterns as well. there is no general-purpose trusted-attention channel inside the model. the agent runtime must establish provenance, isolation, parsing, and least exposure before data enters context. the recurring category error: treating “inside the window” as “the model will remember,” treating “attended to” as “caused the answer,” or treating distinct role tokens as permission isolation. all three mistake a statistical computation surface for a deterministic system boundary. 可复用判断 reusable judgments decoder-only transformer 的每层交替进行跨位置通信（attention）和位置内计算（mlp），并把增量写回 residual stream。 query-key 决定读取路由，value 携带被混合的内容；attention weight 本身不是最终答案的完整因果解释。 causal mask 只阻止读取未来 token，不编码消息信任等级；agent 的权限和数据边界必须由 runtime 保证。 context window 给出可访问范围，而非检索、记忆或正确使用的保证；长 observation 需要结构化、压缩和位置敏感 eval。 模型 hidden state 是一次调用中的临时计算状态；durable task state、幂等性和恢复点必须显式外置。 every decoder-only transformer layer alternates cross-position communication through attention with per-position computation through an mlp, adding both updates to the residual stream. query-key similarity controls read routing and values carry mixed content; attention weights alone are not a complete causal explanation of the final answer. a causal mask blocks future tokens but does not encode message trust. agent permissions and data boundaries must be enforced by the runtime. a context window defines the accessible range, not guaranteed retrieval, memory, or correct use. long observations need structure, compression, and position-sensitive evaluation. model hidden state is temporary computation within one call. durable task state, idempotency, and recovery checkpoints must remain explicit and external. 一手资料 primary sources vaswani et al., attention is all you need — transformer、scaled dot-product attention、multi-head attention、position encoding 与 residual connection 的原始论文。今天的主公式来自这里；论文原架构是 encoder-decoder，与现代 decoder-only llm 并不完全相同。 brown et al., language models are few-shot learners — gpt-3 的 decoder-style autoregressive transformer、in-context learning 设置与 scaling 描述。论文报告的行为不等同于所有后续模型的保证。 su et al., roformer: enhanced transformer with rotary position embedding — rope 的原始形式，解释通过旋转 query/key 表达相对位置。现代实现常有变体，具体模型应以其配置和源码为准。 elhage et al., a mathematical framework for transformer circuits — residual stream、attention head 与路径展开的分析框架。这是研究者提出的 mechanistic interpretability 框架，不应被误写成对所有内部语义的已完成解释。 liu et al., lost in the middle — 作者在多文档问答与 key-value retrieval 上报告长上下文位置效应；本文将其作为需要目标模型复验的风险信号，而非普遍定律。 vaswani et al., attention is all you need — the original treatment of the transformer, scaled dot-product and multi-head attention, positional encoding, and residual connections. today's central equations come from this paper. its architecture is encoder-decoder rather than identical to a modern decoder-only llm. brown et al., language models are few-shot learners — describes gpt-3's decoder-style autoregressive transformer, in-context learning setup, and scaling. reported behavior in the paper is not a guarantee for every later model. su et al., roformer: enhanced transformer with rotary position embedding — introduces rope and explains how rotating queries and keys expresses relative position. modern implementations have variants, so a specific model's configuration and source remain authoritative. elhage et al., a mathematical framework for transformer circuits — develops the residual-stream, attention-head, and path-expansion analysis used in mechanistic interpretability. it is a research framework, not a completed explanation of all internal semantics. liu et al., lost in the middle — reports position effects on multi-document question answering and key-value retrieval. we treat it as a risk signal requiring evaluation on the target model, not as a universal law. 明天从哪里继续 where we continue tomorrow 今天已建立： token embedding 与位置信息初始化 residual stream；每层以 causal self-attention 做受限的跨位置读取，以 mlp 做位置内非线性计算；两者逐层累加，最后位置经 unembedding 变成 logits。我们也明确了 context 可见性、attention routing、角色信任和持久状态之间的边界。 仍未解决： 如果每生成一个 token 都重复整套计算，长对话为什么还能工作？下一篇进入 llm 内核第 3/3 篇：区分 prefill 与 decode，拆开 kv cache 的时间和显存成本，解释 batching、context length 与 agent 多轮 tool loop 的 latency/economics，并把三篇串成完整执行模型。 established today: token embeddings and position initialize the residual stream; every layer performs constrained cross-position reads with causal self-attention and nonlinear per-position computation with an mlp; those updates accumulate until the final position is unembedded into logits. we also separated context visibility, attention routing, role trust, and durable state. still unresolved: if the full computation repeats for every generated token, how can long conversations be practical? the final llm internals installment will separate prefill from decode, unpack the time and memory cost of the kv cache, explain batching and context length in multi-turn agent tool loops, and connect all three parts into one execution model.

title.zh: 下一个 token，如何变成 Agent 的下一步行动？
title.en: How Does the Next Token Become an Agent's Next Action?

text: 下一个 token，如何变成 agent 的下一步行动？ how does the next token become an agent's next action? llm 内核 llm internals llm next-token prediction tool calling agent runtime 今日命题 today's proposition 一个常见但危险的心智模型是：llm 在内部先形成一个完整计划，再把计划逐字打印出来。更接近事实的说法是：在每个位置，模型根据当前上下文计算词表上所有候选 token 的分布，选择一个 token，把它追加到上下文，然后重复。一次工具调用、一个 json 参数、甚至一句“我需要先搜索”，都必须经过这条逐 token 的生成链。 token 也不等于“一个词”。tokenizer 可能把中文单字、英文词根、空格、标点、json 引号或协议控制符切成不同单元。同一个工具参数在字符层看似简单，在模型看来可能要经过许多次局部选择。这解释了为什么长 id、罕见路径、精确引号和嵌套 json 容易出错：模型必须连续多步都落在正确 token 上。schema constraint 能缩小每一步的候选集合，但不能替模型理解参数含义。 这并不意味着模型“只是 autocomplete”，因而不能规划。训练把大量语言、代码、推理轨迹和工具使用模式压进参数；上下文则把当前目标、工具定义和历史结果放到模型面前。模型可以在逐步生成中实现复杂计算，就像 cpu 由简单指令组成却能运行大型程序。关键区别是： cpu 的转移规则由程序确定，llm 的转移是条件概率分布；agent 的可靠性因此不能只靠模型。 还要避免另一个极端：说“只是预测 token”并没有解释模型如何得到分布。transformer 在每一步进行大量向量运算，hidden state 可以编码尚未写出的中间特征、候选计划和不确定性；只是这些内部表示并不自动获得系统权限，也不是可直接执行的动作。工程边界仍然落在可观察的输出协议上。 今天要建立的边界： 模型负责提出下一段符号；runtime 负责判定这些符号是文本还是动作、是否允许执行、怎样执行，以及结果如何回到下一轮上下文。 a common but dangerous mental model says that an llm first forms a complete plan internally and then prints that plan word by word. a closer description is this: at every position, the model computes a distribution over candidate tokens from the current context, selects one token, appends it to the context, and repeats. a tool call, a json argument, and even the sentence “i should search first” must all pass through this token-by-token generation process. a token is not the same thing as a word. a tokenizer may assign separate units to a chinese character, an english stem, whitespace, punctuation, a json quote, or a protocol control marker. a tool argument that looks simple at the character level can require many local choices from the model. this helps explain why long identifiers, rare paths, exact quotation, and nested json are fragile: many consecutive token decisions must all land correctly. a schema constraint can reduce the legal candidate set at each step, but it cannot make the model understand the intended meaning of an argument. this does not mean the model is “only autocomplete” and therefore cannot plan. training compresses patterns from language, code, reasoning traces, and tool use into the parameters; context supplies the current goal, tool definitions, and previous results. complex computation can emerge through sequential generation, just as a cpu runs large programs from simple instructions. the crucial difference is that a cpu transition is fixed by a program, while an llm transition is a conditional probability distribution; agent reliability therefore cannot come from the model alone. a second extreme is equally misleading: saying “it only predicts tokens” does not explain how the distribution is computed. a transformer performs substantial vector computation at every step. its hidden states may encode intermediate features, candidate plans, and uncertainty that have not been written out. those internal representations, however, do not automatically gain system permissions and are not directly executable actions. the engineering boundary still lies at the observable output protocol. the boundary to establish today: the model proposes the next symbols; the runtime decides whether those symbols are text or an action, whether execution is allowed, how it runs, and how the result enters the next context. 连接你熟悉的 loop connect it to the loop you know 你已经熟悉典型 loop：构造上下文 → 调模型 → 发现 tool call → 执行工具 → 把结果追加回上下文 → 再调模型。现在把“调模型”这一步展开：runtime 发送的不是抽象意图，而是一串 token，包括 system/developer instructions、用户消息、工具名称、描述和参数 schema。模型返回的也不是 javascript 函数对象，而是协议定义的输出 token，服务端或 sdk 将其解析成结构化 item。 因此 agent loop 实际上是两层状态机的组合。 内层是模型的自回归 token loop ，终止于 end token、tool-call 边界或长度限制； 外层是 runtime 的 action loop ，负责验证、执行与重新组装上下文。很多“模型问题”其实发生在两层交界：schema 含糊导致参数分布发散，工具输出过长污染下一轮上下文，runtime 重试造成重复副作用，或者 stop condition 把仍需继续的轨迹提前截断。 while (!done) { response = model(context, toolschemas) // 内层：逐 token 生成 if (response.type === "tool_call") { call = validate(response) result = await executewithpolicy(call) // 外层：真实副作用 context.push(call, result) } else { done = acceptfinal(response) } } you already know the typical loop: assemble context → call the model → detect a tool call → execute it → append the result → call the model again. now expand “call the model.” the runtime sends no abstract intention. it sends tokens representing system and developer instructions, user messages, tool names, descriptions, and parameter schemas. the model does not return a javascript function object either. it emits protocol-defined output tokens that a service or sdk parses into a structured item. an agent loop is therefore a composition of two state machines. the inner machine is the model's autoregressive token loop , ending at an end token, a tool-call boundary, or a length limit. the outer machine is the runtime action loop , which validates, executes, and reassembles context. many apparent “model problems” occur at this boundary: an ambiguous schema spreads probability across bad arguments, a long tool result contaminates the next context, a retry duplicates a side effect, or a stop condition truncates a trajectory that still needs work. while (!done) { response = model(context, toolschemas) // inner: token generation if (response.type === "tool_call") { call = validate(response) result = await executewithpolicy(call) // outer: real side effect context.push(call, result) } else { done = acceptfinal(response) } } 从 logits 到副作用 from logits to side effects 一次生成从 tokenization 开始。文本和协议标记被映射成整数 id；embedding table 把 id 映射成向量。经过多层 transformer 后，最后位置的 hidden state 被投影成一个与词表同宽的 logits 向量。logit 不是概率，只是每个候选 token 的未归一化分数；softmax 才把它转换成概率分布。 假设上下文中有用户目标“查北京天气”和工具定义 get_weather(location) 。训练让模型学到：在相似上下文里，产生工具调用标记、工具名和合法参数往往比直接编造天气更符合目标。于是第一枚特殊 token 可能落在 tool_call 分支。之后工具名与参数仍然逐 token 生成，只是 decoding 可以受到 grammar 或 json schema 约束：不合法的下一 token 被屏蔽，剩余概率重新归一化。 从上下文 token 到工具执行结果的两层循环 上下文 token 目标 + tools + history transformer hidden state logits → 分布 逐 token decoding tool call name + args runtime：校验 · 授权 · 执行 · 记录 tool result 追加回下一轮上下文 原创示意：上方是模型的 token loop；下方是 runtime 的 action loop。只有 runtime 跨越了“符号 → 真实副作用”的边界。 在真实 api 中，协议层还会把这条 token 流包装成 output item。streaming 客户端可能先收到“工具调用开始”，再收到参数 delta，最后才收到完整 call；runtime 不应在参数尚未闭合时执行。一个 call id 用于把之后的 tool result 与原请求配对。这些 item 是传输与状态管理抽象，不改变底层自回归事实，却决定了重试、并行调用和断线恢复能否正确实现。 schema-constrained decoding 提高的是 语法符合率 ，不是 语义正确率 。参数可以完全符合 json schema，却把城市写错、选择了危险工具、遗漏业务约束。执行前仍需语义验证、权限判断、幂等策略和人工审批边界。工具返回后，模型看到的通常又只是文本或结构化 token；它没有直接“感受”数据库或浏览器，只看到 runtime 选择暴露的观察结果。 这也解释了为什么 tool result 必须被视为不可信输入。网页、数据库字段或 shell 输出可能含有看似指令的文字；一旦追加进上下文，它会和其他 token 一起影响分布。runtime 需要保留来源和 trust level，隔离数据与指令，必要时截断、转义或让独立 parser 提取字段，而不是假设模型天然知道哪段话有权改变目标。 generation begins with tokenization. text and protocol markers become integer ids; an embedding table maps those ids to vectors. after many transformer layers, the hidden state at the final position is projected into a logits vector as wide as the vocabulary. a logit is not a probability, only an unnormalized score for a candidate token; softmax converts the scores into a probability distribution. suppose the context contains the goal “check beijing weather” and a tool definition get_weather(location) . training has taught the model that, in similar contexts, producing a tool-call marker, a tool name, and valid arguments often fits the objective better than inventing weather. the first special token may therefore enter a tool_call branch. the name and arguments are still generated token by token, but decoding can be constrained by a grammar or json schema: illegal next tokens are masked and the remaining probabilities are renormalized. two nested loops from context tokens to tool results context tokens goal + tools + history transformer hidden state logits → distribution token decoding tool call name + args runtime: validate · authorize · execute · record append tool result to the next context original explanatory diagram: the upper path is the model's token loop; the lower path is the runtime's action loop. only the runtime crosses from symbols into real side effects. in a real api, the protocol layer wraps this token stream into output items. a streaming client may first receive the start of a tool call, then argument deltas, and only later the completed call; the runtime must not execute while the argument object is still incomplete. a call id pairs the later tool result with the originating request. these items are transport and state-management abstractions. they do not change the underlying autoregressive process, but they determine whether retries, parallel calls, and connection recovery can be implemented correctly. schema-constrained decoding improves syntactic conformance , not semantic correctness . arguments may perfectly match json schema while naming the wrong city, selecting a dangerous tool, or omitting a business constraint. execution still requires semantic validation, authorization, idempotency policy, and human-approval boundaries. once a tool returns, the model normally sees only text or structured tokens again. it does not directly “feel” a database or browser; it sees the observation that the runtime chose to expose. this also explains why a tool result must be treated as untrusted input. a webpage, database field, or shell output can contain language that looks like an instruction. once appended to context, those tokens influence the distribution alongside everything else. the runtime should preserve provenance and trust level, separate data from instructions, and truncate, escape, or independently parse fields when necessary instead of assuming the model inherently knows which text has authority to change the goal. 必要数学：分解与采样 essential math: factorization and sampling 语言模型给整段输出 y 的概率，不是一次算出，而是用 chain rule 分解为每个 token 的条件概率乘积： p(y₁,…,yₜ | x) = ∏ᵢ p(yᵢ | x, y₁,…,yᵢ₋₁) x 是生成前已有的上下文； yᵢ 是第 i 个输出 token。这个式子解释了两件工程事实。第一，早期一个小错误会进入后续条件，改变整条轨迹；tool name 选错后，参数往往会继续“合理地”为错误工具服务。第二，长轨迹不是一个原子决策，而是一连串局部决策，因此 context management、阶段性验证和可恢复 checkpoint 很重要。 训练时，基础语言模型通常最小化真实下一个 token 的 negative log-likelihood，也就是 cross-entropy。若真实 token 是 y，损失可写作： l = −log p(y | context) 当模型给真实 token 的概率越低，惩罚越大。对海量序列反复优化后，参数学到哪些 token 在哪些上下文后更可能出现。这个目标没有直接写入“完成用户业务目标”或“永不调用危险工具”；这些行为来自训练数据、后训练反馈、推理时 instructions 以及 runtime 约束的共同作用。也因此，低 training loss 与高 agent task success 不是同一个指标。 每一步的概率来自 logits z 的 softmax。temperature τ 控制分布的尖锐程度： p(token = j) = exp(zⱼ / τ) ÷ σₖ exp(zₖ / τ) τ 较低时，高 logit token 更占优势，输出通常更稳定；τ 较高时，低分候选获得更多概率，探索性增加。但 temperature 不是“正确性旋钮”。如果错误 tool call 本来就是最高分，降低温度只会更稳定地犯错。greedy decoding 取最高概率 token，也不等于得到全序列最高概率，更不等于得到业务上最优动作。 如果一条 100-token 参数序列中每一步平均有 99% 概率选中期望 token，粗略相乘得到整段完全匹配的概率约为 0.99¹⁰⁰ ≈ 36.6%。真实决策并不独立，平均概率也不会固定，但这个例子说明：局部很准不代表长串精确复制可靠。不要要求模型背出 opaque id；让 runtime 查询、枚举、校验或用短别名映射。 工具 schema 约束可以看作在每一步建立合法集合 a，把不在 a 中的 token 概率设为 0，再归一化。这能消除无效 json，却无法表达所有真实约束，例如“退款超过 500 元必须审批”。后者属于 runtime policy，而不是 decoding grammar。 a language model does not assign the probability of a complete output sequence y in one indivisible step. by the chain rule, it factorizes that probability into a product of next-token conditionals: p(y₁,…,yₜ | x) = ∏ᵢ p(yᵢ | x, y₁,…,yᵢ₋₁) x is the context available before generation and yᵢ is the i-th output token. this equation explains two engineering facts. first, an early error becomes part of every later condition and changes the whole trajectory; after selecting the wrong tool name, the model may continue producing arguments that are locally coherent for that wrong tool. second, a long trajectory is not an atomic decision but a chain of local decisions, making context management, intermediate verification, and recoverable checkpoints important. during training, a base language model typically minimizes the negative log-likelihood of the observed next token, equivalently a cross-entropy loss. if the observed token is y, the loss is: l = −log p(y | context) the lower the probability assigned to the observed token, the larger the penalty. repeating this optimization over enormous collections of sequences teaches the parameters which tokens tend to follow which contexts. the objective does not directly say “complete the user's business goal” or “never call a dangerous tool.” those behaviors emerge from the combined effects of training data, post-training feedback, inference-time instructions, and runtime constraints. low training loss and high agent task success are therefore different metrics. at each position, probabilities come from a softmax over logits z . temperature τ controls the sharpness of the distribution: p(token = j) = exp(zⱼ / τ) ÷ σₖ exp(zₖ / τ) at a lower τ, high-logit tokens dominate and output is usually more stable. at a higher τ, lower-scoring candidates receive more probability and exploration increases. temperature is not a “correctness knob,” however. if a wrong tool call already has the highest score, lowering temperature merely makes that mistake more repeatable. greedy decoding takes the highest-probability token at each step; that is not guaranteed to produce the highest-probability complete sequence, much less the best action under a business objective. if every position in a 100-token argument sequence had an average 99% chance of producing the intended token, a crude product gives only 0.99¹⁰⁰ ≈ 36.6% probability of an exact match. real token decisions are not independent and their probabilities are not constant, but the example exposes an important design rule: high local accuracy does not make long exact reproduction reliable. do not ask a model to memorize opaque identifiers when the runtime can query, enumerate, validate, or map a short alias. a tool schema constraint can be viewed as defining a legal set a at each step, setting the probability of tokens outside a to zero, and renormalizing. this removes invalid json but cannot express every real constraint, such as “refunds over $500 require approval.” that belongs in runtime policy, not the decoding grammar. 对 agent 设计的影响 implications for agent design 1. tool description 是概率控制面 名称、描述、参数 schema 会进入上下文，影响下一 token 分布。两个语义重叠的工具会竞争概率；含糊描述会增加错误选择。tool design 不只是 api ergonomics，也是模型决策界面。 2. observation 决定下一轮世界 模型只知道被追加回上下文的结果。把 20 mb 日志原样塞回去，不等于“提供更多信息”；关键错误可能被埋没，还会消耗 context 和 attention。runtime 应把 observation 设计成紧凑、带来源、可验证、保留关键失败细节的对象。 3. 权限不能来自 prompt “不要删除生产数据”只是一段会影响概率的 token，不是权限边界。真正的边界必须在模型之外：凭据 scope、allowlist、sandbox、审批、dry-run 和资源配额。prompt 可以帮助选择，但不能授予或撤销能力。 4. verification 要切断错误累积 因为序列概率逐步分解，错误会沿轨迹传播。在高风险节点加入类型检查、状态断言、测试、独立 reviewer 或环境反馈，相当于在外层 loop 建立新的观测与分支，而不是让模型基于错误前提继续流畅生成。 1. tool descriptions are a probabilistic control surface names, descriptions, and parameter schemas enter the context and influence the next-token distribution. semantically overlapping tools compete for probability; ambiguous descriptions increase selection error. tool design is not merely api ergonomics—it is the model's decision interface. 2. an observation defines the next world the model knows only the result appended to context. dumping a 20 mb log does not necessarily “provide more information.” the decisive error can be buried while context and attention are consumed. the runtime should shape observations into compact, attributable, verifiable objects that preserve critical failure detail. 3. permission cannot come from a prompt “do not delete production data” is a sequence of tokens that influences probability, not a permission boundary. the real boundary must live outside the model: credential scope, allowlists, sandboxing, approvals, dry runs, and resource quotas. a prompt can guide selection but cannot grant or revoke capability. 4. verification must interrupt error accumulation because sequence probability factorizes step by step, errors propagate along a trajectory. type checks, state assertions, tests, an independent reviewer, or environment feedback at high-risk points create a new observation and branch in the outer loop instead of letting the model fluently continue from a false premise. 取舍与失败模式 trade-offs and failure modes 结构化输出 vs. 表达能力： 严格 schema 能大幅降低解析失败，但 schema 越复杂、动态变化越频繁，越会占用上下文、增加首次处理成本，并可能让模型在错误抽象里稳定输出。先让工具边界简单，再要求模型遵守。 单次大调用 vs. 外层 loop： 把整个任务交给一次超长 generation，runtime 简单，但中途不可观测、不可验证、失败重做成本高。细粒度 loop 增加编排开销，却能 checkpoint、重试具体步骤并在副作用前审批。粒度应围绕可验证状态转移，而不是追求调用次数最少。 确定性 vs. 探索： 低 temperature、固定 tool choice 和严格 grammar 提高重复性，适合稳定工作流；但复杂研究与 debugging 可能需要探索多个假设。更可靠的做法常是让探索发生在无副作用的候选生成阶段，再由 evaluator 或环境测试收敛，而不是直接提高执行阶段随机性。 看起来会推理 vs. 已完成： 自然语言解释很流畅，只说明生成轨迹在语言分布上合理。它不证明文件已写入、交易已提交、测试已通过或目标状态已达到。completion 必须由环境状态和 verifier 定义。模型的“done”只是一个提案。 最值得记住的失败模式： 把符合 schema 的 tool call 当成正确决策，把模型自报完成当成环境已完成，把 prompt prohibition 当成权限控制。 structured output versus expressiveness: a strict schema can greatly reduce parsing failures, but a complex or frequently changing schema consumes context, can add first-use processing cost, and may cause the model to produce stable output inside the wrong abstraction. make the tool boundary simple before demanding conformance. one large call versus an outer loop: delegating the whole task to one long generation simplifies the runtime but makes intermediate work unobservable and unverifiable, while failures are expensive to redo. a fine-grained loop adds orchestration overhead but enables checkpoints, step-level retries, and approval before side effects. choose granularity around verifiable state transitions, not the fewest possible model calls. determinism versus exploration: low temperature, fixed tool choice, and strict grammars improve repeatability for stable workflows. complex research and debugging may need multiple hypotheses. a more reliable pattern is to explore in a side-effect-free candidate stage and then converge through evaluators or environment tests, rather than making the execution stage more random. apparently reasoned versus actually complete: a fluent explanation only shows that the generated trajectory is plausible under the language distribution. it does not prove that a file was written, a transaction committed, a test passed, or a target state reached. completion must be defined by environment state and a verifier. the model's “done” is only a proposal. the failure pattern worth remembering: treating a schema-valid call as a correct decision, treating self-reported completion as completed environment state, or treating a prompt prohibition as access control. 可复用判断 reusable judgments agent 不是 llm 内部的一项单独能力，而是 token generator 与 runtime state machine 的组合系统。 tool call 从模型侧仍是逐 token 生成；结构化约束保证格式，不保证意图、权限或业务正确性。 prompt、tool schema 和 observation 都是概率控制面；credential、sandbox、approval 和 verifier 才是确定性控制面。 长任务可靠性来自在外层 loop 中不断把环境事实重新引入，而不是让单次生成变得无限长。 任何“完成”都应由环境状态判定，不能由模型的最后一句话判定。 an agent is not a separate capability hidden inside an llm; it is a system composed of a token generator and a runtime state machine. from the model's side, a tool call is still generated token by token. structural constraints guarantee format, not intent, authorization, or business correctness. prompts, tool schemas, and observations are probabilistic control surfaces. credentials, sandboxes, approvals, and verifiers are deterministic control surfaces. long-task reliability comes from repeatedly reintroducing environment facts through the outer loop, not from making one generation infinitely long. environment state—not the model's final sentence—must define completion. 一手资料 primary sources vaswani et al., attention is all you need — transformer 与 attention 架构的原始论文。今天只使用了“上下文经过 transformer 产生下一 token logits”这一层；attention 机制将在后续专题展开。
